title: Fuzz Testing Suite — reference solution and review guide
answer: A strong Fuzz Testing Suite solution should meet the objective: Generate varied input values against documented constraints and assert that all valid and invalid values follow the specification. Record the seed/configuration where supported. It should use a repeatable local test setup and explain why the selected rules preserve the intended behavior.
explanation: Review technical correctness, authorization, boundary behavior, repeatability, and limitation statements. Do not treat a passing demo as a comprehensive security assessment.

review_rubric.criterion: Technical correctness and fit to task
